name: com.litescrape/litescrape-mcp-server
title: Litescrape
description: Google, Bing, DuckDuckGo and Google Maps free without an API key, plus 130+ more tools found on demand.

environmentVariables.name: LITESCRAPE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional Litescrape API key. Without it, google_search, bing_search, google_maps and duckduckgo_search work from a free daily allowance; with it every other tool find_tools finds (google_ai_mode, google_shopping, web_fetch and the rest of the Litescrape catalog) runs through call_tool too and the limits are lifted.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional: Bearer <Litescrape API key>. Without it the same free daily allowance applies.
